concerns.text: FR-001 (CSV ingestion & SMILES validation) is only partially covered – task T012 (implement ingest.py) is still pending and error‑handling tasks T013/T014 (log `[MISSING_DATA_EXCLUDED]` and `[ERROR_SMILES]`) are also unimplemented, leaving the functional requirement unfulfilled.
FR-005 (paired t‑test) is not satisfied – task T021 (evaluation report generation with Pearson r, RMSE, and hypothesis_status) is marked incomplete, so the required statistical comparison is missing.

FR-006 (sensitivity analysis & ablation) is incomplete – tasks T043 (generate `sensitivity_report.json`) and T027 (create `sensitivity_summary.md` with stability field) remain undone, breaking the sensitivity‑analysis requirement.

FR-007 (logging of missing/invalid data) is only half‑implemented – while T005 creates the log tags, the downstream handling tasks T013 (exclude missing data) and T014 (skip invalid SMILES) are still open, so the requirement to log and exclude such records is not fully met.
SC-001 (hypothesis_status field in evaluation report) cannot be satisfied because the evaluation JSON is not produced (T021 incomplete).
SC-002 (reporting Pearson r and RMSE) is missing for the same reason – without a completed T021 the measurable success criteria are absent.
SC-003 (total runtime report) is not delivered – task T035 (aggregate `resource_summary.json`) is still pending, leaving the runtime measurement undefined.
SC-004 (stability of correlation across sensitivity sweep) cannot be verified because the required reports T043 and T027 are not produced.
SC-005 (peak‑memory capture) is unimplemented – task T006e (record `peak_memory_mb` in `runtime_memory.json`) is still open, so memory‑usage verification is absent.

Contract test T015 references a non‑existent schema file (`specs/.../dataset.schema.yaml`), preventing validation of the featurized JSONL against the specification and thus dropping an acceptance criterion.
